name: INTREPID
fullName: Fever Prevention in Patients With Acute Vascular Brain Injury
population: n=677, median 62; 51% female, NIHSS critically ill: 254 ischemic stroke, 223 ICH, 200 SAH, up to 14 days or ICU discharge
finding: Fever burden markedly reduced — prevention is achievable
teachingPoint: Device-based fever prevention reduced fever burden but did not improve 3-month function; halted for futility.

name: SETPOINT2
fullName: Early vs Standard Approach to Tracheostomy in Severe Stroke Receiving Mechanical Ventilation
population: n=382, median 59; 49.8% women, NIHSS severe acute ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke requiring invasive ventilation, 6-month outcome
finding: No significant benefit from early tracheostomy
teachingPoint: Early (<=5 day) tracheostomy did not improve 6-month outcome in ventilated severe stroke; a third of controls avoided tracheostomy entirely.
